_comment: Implementation-stage classification declarations, consumed by scripts/workflow_fingerprint.py's load_implementation_stage_classification() (WF4a-i). Non-immutable registry metadata -- lives under docs/ai-workflow/registry/, already a PLAN_STAGE_EXCLUDED_PREFIXES entry, so editing this file never changes review_content_id or stales the plan approval. 'protected' here means the content technical_approval binds to (source, test, build, migration, workflow-command files, per D-Commit-Provenance); 'excluded' means plan-stage-governed design content or runtime-mutable state that is never itself an implementation deliverable. Any path named in neither set fails closed (UnclassifiedPathError), same discipline as the plan-stage classifier.

protected_prefixes..claude/commands/: workflow-command files this milestone creates or modifies -- exactly the 'workflow-command file' category D-Commit-Provenance names as implementation-stage-critical
protected_prefixes.scripts/: this milestone's own tooling scripts (the fingerprint/state modules and their tests) -- same content category as .claude/commands/ above
protected_prefixes.app/: product source and test code -- protected here (unlike at the plan stage, where it is not yet approval-critical) because it is exactly the content a functional-remediation checkpoint (D-Functional-Remediation) may touch once Milestone 8 is adopted mid-implementation
protected_prefixes.gradle/: product build configuration a concurrent product checkpoint may touch

protected_paths..github/workflows/ci.yml: CI wiring is exactly the kind of build-tooling change technical_approval must bind to, even though the design decision it implements is separately protected at the plan stage

excluded_prefixes.docs/ai-workflow/registry/: plan-stage-governed registry/artifact-declaration files (including this file itself) -- not an implementation deliverable in their own right
excluded_prefixes.docs/ai-workflow/requirements/: plan-stage-governed requirements mapping/ledger files, same reasoning as docs/ai-workflow/registry/ above
excluded_prefixes.docs/ai-workflow/archive/: this work item's own completed-content archival, same exclusion as the plan stage
excluded_prefixes.docs/milestones/: product milestone plan/execution artifacts, out of scope for this process work item
excluded_prefixes.docs/adr/: product architecture-decision records, a concurrent product work item's own content
excluded_prefixes.docs/agent-context/: stale product agent-context docs, out of scope for this process work item
excluded_prefixes..github/: operational GitHub configuration outside this milestone's own ci.yml wiring, carved out above by exact path

excluded_paths.CLAUDE.md: process-command depointer edits implement the design, they are not implementation deliverables themselves
excluded_paths.AGENTS.md: product-repo documentation, out of scope for this process work item
excluded_paths.README.md: product-repo documentation, out of scope for this process work item
excluded_paths.docs/PROJECT_BRIEF.md: product-repo documentation, out of scope for this process work item
excluded_paths.docs/DOMAIN_GLOSSARY.md: product-repo documentation, out of scope for this process work item
excluded_paths.docs/UX_FLOWS.md: product-repo documentation, out of scope for this process work item
excluded_paths.docs/ACTIVE_MILESTONE.md: product-milestone narrative, out of scope for this process work item -- may be written by a concurrent product work item while this one is mid-implementation
excluded_paths.docs/ROADMAP.md: product milestone ordering, same reasoning as docs/ACTIVE_MILESTONE.md above
excluded_paths.docs/ai-workflow/WORKFLOW_STATE.json: runtime-mutable per-work-item state -- excluded so ordinary phase/checkpoint writes never stale technical_approval
excluded_paths.docs/ai-workflow/WORKFLOW_CONFIG.json: runtime-mutable repository-level config, same reasoning as WORKFLOW_STATE.json above
excluded_paths.docs/ai-workflow/MILESTONE_WORKFLOW.md: plan-stage-governed workflow documentation, not an implementation deliverable
excluded_paths.docs/ai-workflow/REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md: plan-stage-governed workflow documentation, not an implementation deliverable
excluded_paths.docs/ai-workflow/PLAN_REVIEW_WORKFLOW.md: plan-stage-governed workflow documentation, not an implementation deliverable
excluded_paths.docs/ai-workflow/WORKFLOW_V2_PLAN.md: plan-stage design content, already governed by the plan approval -- not an implementation deliverable
excluded_paths.docs/ai-workflow/WORKFLOW_V2_AUDIT.md: plan-stage design content, already governed by the plan approval -- not an implementation deliverable
excluded_paths.docs/TECHNICAL_DECISIONS.md: plan-stage design content, already governed by the plan approval -- not an implementation deliverable
